comments.author: SlaveToTheGames
comments.body_html:
Combat Paint head: This one actually is perfect. Great work.

SOAP head: Eyes need to be smaller and shaped better. I also suggest darkening everything to give it the effect of being more detailed. Eyes are also not aligned correctly (The left eye is higher than the right by a good amount).

Stathem Head: Everything is good enough except the eyes. They are pretty bad and need work. Low texture, cross-eyed and look gooey.

Snow head: This would actually be my favorite head however there is more than a few issues holding this back from being the best. The glossy/shiny effect needs to be removed 90% it makes it look plastic and horrible. The blood needs to be significantly darker but everything else about it is fine. Eyes could use a little work but are fine as is.

Great attempt at adding more models! If possible I would love to see someone retouch the original heads as well

P.s. Here is photos of each head for you to use and others to see showing (Front, Side, Back) profile of each head. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pJo_KBACPGvjQ0EmL1jrLyWYOt-3VaPR?usp=sharing
